title: THE STAMINA WORD SITS BESIDE ITS BAR
why: Seen on the HUD screenshot of 2026-10-04: STAMINA was dark text inside a 12 unit bar in a face taller than the bar, so it spilled over the top edge and read as a smudge. It sits just past the end of the bar now, in the bar colour, and WINDED still replaces it when the bar locks.
now: The stamina label sits beside its bar instead of spilling over it.
